text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Submissions wanted!! I would like to 
solicit PR proposals for the academy from 
all of you working here at Tracen Academy!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
To further revitalize Tracen Academy—and 
by extension, the racing world—I await 
your passion-filled proposals!
choice_data_list: Huh…… Maybe I'll give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I see... A project to make a school drama 
from scratch set right here at Tracen 
Academy. It sounds interesting, but――
choice_data_list: へえ……やってみようかな！
choice_data_list_en: Oh... Maybe I'll give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Colleagues
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't that whole new direction a bit of a 
bottleneck?" "There's no precedent for it, 
after all..." "Without a guarantee it'll 
work out, it makes you a little uneasy~"
choice_data_list: だろう？新機軸かなって！
でしょう？新機軸かなって！
choice_data_list_en: Right? Thought it was a fresh approach!
Right? Thought it'd be an innovative approach!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Trying something totally new is what 
makes it awesome! A huge challenge is 
totally hype, right?♪
choice_data_list: いや、でもさ――！
choice_data_list_en: No, but come on—!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Leave conquering the blue ocean to me♪ So 
let's hammer out the plan, shall we? Come 
on, come on!
choice_data_list: 君は……
貴方は……
choice_data_list_en: You're...
You're...

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
When presenting, isn't it better to show 
visual images alongside text?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
And with that, I've assigned our roles! To 
all our talented actors and actresses~

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! When it comes to acting, look 
no further than me! With a performance 
this gorgeous and dazzling, the 
"End-of-Century Overlord" shall win over 
even more adoring fans!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A drama set right here at the academy? For 
the sake of our future junior pony-chans, 
I'd love to help out.
choice_data_list:
You've gone that far just in the planning 
stage?!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Of course! If you really want a proposal 
approved, you gotta make an impact with 
the first impression!
choice_data_list: 企画段階でそこまで！？
choice_data_list_en: That far ahead during just the planning phase?!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
All right! Next up, let's make a concept 
video based on this theme.
choice_data_list: ……っ、そうだね！
choice_data_list_en: ...! You're right!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Yep. What kind of academy charm do you 
want this drama to capture? —What do you 
love most about our academy?
choice_data_list: コンセプト？
choice_data_list_en: A concept?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Yep. What kind of academy charm do you 
want this drama to capture? —What do you 
love most about our academy?
choice_data_list: 生徒たちがそれぞれの夢を抱いて――
choice_data_list_en: With each student chasing their own dreams—

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh, uh-huh.
choice_data_list: 生徒たちがそれぞれの夢を抱いて――
choice_data_list_en: With each student chasing their own dreams—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. I find this academy truly 
endearing for that very reason.
choice_data_list: それに向かって挑戦できる場所であること！
choice_data_list_en: That it's a place where we can rise to that challenge!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Okay. Then let's build the concept around 
that as our guideline! I'll share the 
trend data, so take a look through it. 
We've already got what matters, so we 
totally got this.
choice_data_list: Something precious to you?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Passion♪ Without that, you can't even get 
started, right?
choice_data_list: 大事なもの？
choice_data_list_en: Something important?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
All right, that wraps it up. Go present it 
to the chairwoman with your head held 
high.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Everything you want to do, with all your 
might!
choice_data_list: Ah!
Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Whatever you want to do, give it your 
absolute all!
choice_data_list: ああ！
うん！
choice_data_list_en: Yeah!
Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey, it's the Trainer from the other 
day! How'd the presentation go?
choice_data_list: ああ！
うん！
choice_data_list_en: Yeah!
Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
For real!? You did it! Let's celebrate 
with seasonal parfaits♪
choice_data_list: 一次選考通ったよ！ありがとう！
choice_data_list_en: I passed the preliminary screening! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
For real!? You did it! Let's celebrate 
with seasonal parfaits♪
choice_data_list: 君が協力してくれたおかげだよ
貴方が協力してくれたおかげだよ
お祝いするには早い気も……
choice_data_list_en: It's all thanks to your help.
It's thanks to your cooperation
It feels a bit too early to celebrate, though...

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: What are you even talking about?
choice_data_list: 君が協力してくれたおかげだよ
貴方が協力してくれたおかげだよ
お祝いするには早い気も……
choice_data_list_en: It's all thanks to your help.
It's thanks to your cooperation
It feels a bit too early to celebrate, though...

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
You were the one who found it first, you 
know? I just gave you an assist.
choice_data_list:
Can I consult you once the proposal gets 
officially approved?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
You're the one who found it first, you 
know? I just gave you an assist.
choice_data_list: 企画が正式採用されたら相談してもいい？
choice_data_list_en: If the project gets officially accepted, can I consult with you?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Totally! It's guaranteed to be a 
super-hyped project, so I can't wait♪
choice_data_list: 企画が正式採用されたら相談してもいい？
choice_data_list_en: If the project gets officially accepted, can I consult with you?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
No, no, even a small success is still a 
success. You've gotta properly praise 
yourself for it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
If we can keep our motivation high like 
this, we'll be able to keep our minds 
running sharp, too.
choice_data_list: Then... maybe I'll throw a celebration!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Yaaaay, that's the spirit♪
choice_data_list: じゃあ……お祝いしちゃおうかな！
choice_data_list_en: Then... maybe I should celebrate!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, alongside Forever Young, I got to 
taste the sweet flavor of success.
